# Extensions

## Registration

Register every `ext.tapir.<verb>` (snake_case, terminal segment only) with `registerTapirExtension(method, handler, {ensureFrames: true})` from `lib/src/utils/tapir_register.dart`, never with `developer.registerExtension` or `registerExtensionIdempotent` directly. It is idempotent across hot restart and, per call, wakes an app whose window is hidden or minimised (`ensureFramesProduced`), so a tap lands and a snapshot is fresh. Pass `ensureFrames: false` for a verb that must see the engine as it is (perf, `boot_id`, `close_app`, `console`, `exceptions`, `semantics_hold`, `evaluate`).

Each `ext_<name>.dart` exposes a `register<Name>Extension(s)()` function that `registerAllTapirExtensions` (`register_tapir_extensions.dart`) calls once from `TapirPlugin.install()`. A new verb also needs its command and MCP descriptor: `commands.md`, Adding a command.

## Handlers

Signature: `Future<ServiceExtensionResponse> Function(String method, Map<String, String> params)`. Every param is a string: parse with `int.tryParse(params['k'] ?? '')`; a list arrives as JSON text. Return the success payload through `tapirResult(payload)`, which adds `framesForced`, `warnings` and `reresolved` when they apply. Errors go through `tapirError(message, TapirErrorEnvelope.<type>(...))` (`utils/error_envelope.dart`), never `ServiceExtensionResponse.error` by hand: the envelope type picks the code (`refused`, a target or session state tapir will not act on, is `-32001`; `invalid_param` and `missing_param` are `-32602`; the rest `-32000`), and the JSON `errorDetail` carries at least `message`.

A verb that embeds a snapshot calls `snapshotForAction(params)` (`ext_snapshot.dart`) after acting: `snapshot` (`full|diff|none`) overrides `includeSnapshot`, and a failed snapshot never turns a successful action into an error. A verb that writes text resolves its field once (`resolveTextFieldTarget`) and refuses a ref that is an interactive non-text control.

## Actionability gate

`ensureActionable` (`utils/actionability_gate.dart`) guards `tap`, `hover`, `drag`, `double_click`, `right_click`, `triple_click`, `type` and `set_checkbox` (the control it taps, when it taps); `scroll`, `select_option` and `press_key` skip it on purpose. Each precondition keeps one test asserting its exact reason substring, so a new check adds one.

## Refs

`RefRegistry.register` dedupes by `SemanticsNode.id`; a `q<N>` re-walks the live tree on every action. Resolve with `resolveRefForAction`. An unmounted `e<N>` is relocated only through its `RefBinding` (label, index, namesake count, route) and only when all of them still match; otherwise the `defunct` error stands. A stale `q<N>` throws `TapirStaleHandleException`.

## Enrichers

A `TapirSnapshotEnricher` returns a YAML fragment for the node or null, synchronously and statelessly: it never retains an `Element` across calls. Wind data arrives through `WindDebugRegistry.current?.resolve(element)` from `wind_kit_diagnostics_contracts` before the enricher loop; never import `wind_kit`.
